# 🛡️ Security Audit Template

## Scope
Repository/build/service, commit/version, auditor, date and included/excluded components.

## Threat boundaries
Identify browser, backend (if present), dependencies, CI, services, stores and trust boundaries.

## Findings
| ID | Severity | Asset | Threat/scenario | Evidence | Recommendation | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

## Dependency and secret review
Record advisory paths, reachability, fixed versions, tracked secret checks, workflow permissions and rotation actions.

## Data protection
Review collection, transport, storage, logs, retention, deletion and backups.

## Verification and exceptions
Record tools, versions, commands, limitations, false positives and accepted-risk expiry.

Auditor, maintainer and residual-risk decision.
